classification: environment-qualified / production capacity certification still gated

edge.qualification: direct Django development endpoint; not production-equivalent

network.qualification: zero-distance topology does not represent production network latency or contention

load_runner.placement: same Windows workstation as application, PostgreSQL and DMS
load_runner.host_cpu: Intel Core i7-1165G7, 4 physical cores, 8 logical processors
